name: FeS-VI
notes: Imported 12.08.2026 from a beamline jcpds collection. Source file(s): JCPDS/dac_user_jcpds/FeS(VI).jcpds. Cell axes and hkl were cyclically permuted into the standard Pnma setting without changing d-spacings. FeS-VI coordinates refined at 56 GPa and 300 K by Ono et al., Earth and Planetary Science Letters 272, 481-487 (2008), doi:10.1016/j.epsl.2008.05.017.

eos_records.label: (VI) Ono 2006
eos_records.notes: Ono and Kikegawa report V0 = 99.5(7) A^3 and K0 = 156(6) GPa with K0' fixed at 4.0.
